text: Westport Albion takes control near their own goal on the left side through Marek Zielinski’s interception. The ball moves quickly up the center and right flank, with a series of precise passes and carries pushing into Kingsmoor FC’s final third. Dylan Rahman races down the right side and crosses the ball into the penalty area near the right post. Rafael Delacroix is positioned just 2 metres from goal on the right, and he strikes the ball with his foot, scoring to level the match at 2-2.
